methods.name: Season-matched radar and optical classification
methods.why: Compare 2018 and 2023 using radar composites, similar seasonal windows, and independent stratified validation with area-adjusted transition estimates.

methods.name: Uncertainty-aware biomass modeling
methods.why: Use GEDI footprints and available plots to calibrate spatial models, propagate classification and biomass uncertainty, and convert biomass to carbon using documented factors.

methods.name: Separate carbon pools
methods.why: Report aboveground carbon separately and do not infer peat stock changes without suitable soil observations.
